name: study-fortune-compass
description: A deterministic Mei Hua Yi Shu academic trend reader with an offline 64-hexagram library, disclosed calculations, reality-grounded calibration, and optional labeled symbolic learning lenses.

displayDescription.en: Cast one number through a disclosed Mei Hua Yi Shu calculation, follow the primary, mutual, and changed hexagrams, then test the reading against your real study context.
displayDescription.zh: 一数起卦，循本卦、互卦与变卦解析学习趋势与盲区，并结合现实信息给出可验证的观察和行动方向。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我最近准备期末考试，选数字7，帮我看本周复习进度该把力气放在哪里
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am preparing for finals and choose number 7. Read this week's study progress and show me where to focus.

quickPrompts.en: Give me today's study reading using number 7, and briefly show how the hexagram was calculated.
quickPrompts.zh: 我选数字7，给我做一张今天的学运日签，并简要展示起卦依据

quickPrompts.en: I am torn between graduate school preparation and an internship. Help me view the choice through the compass.
quickPrompts.zh: 我在考研和找实习之间犹豫，帮我换个视角看看
